field_position_sweep — DRIVE tacscalib op

• Data kinds: matrix × signal × any → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.field_position_sweep(centres, errors, image_shape) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import tacscalib; tacscalib.field_position_sweep(centres, errors, image_shape) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("field_position_sweep"))

Usage

Position dependence of the error: arranges each image's contact center (row, column) and error (e.g. the median) against the distance from the image center, and returns the least-squares slope [error / 100 px] and Spearman's rank correlation (ties get average ranks) (numpy only). Returns: dist_px, err, slope_per_100px, intercept, spearman, n. Raises ValueError: fewer than 3 pairs / shape mismatch / non-finite / shape of image_shape.
